title: notes/<id>
description: his notes (D-325): a title, a course and a body of blocks with inline marks; never HTML
$comment: B-401 (D-325, D-326, D-328): written by the page only. The note's identity (createdAt, earlierOf) is write-once; what he edits is a mark the page changes in place. Archived and discarded are marks, never deletes. The body is structured blocks of plain-text runs: no HTML is stored, and a reader never turns stored text into HTML. Pipelines skip notes as they skip the journal; evening-mac reads them only for its backup and mirror.

title.description: his title; empty until he gives one (the list then reads the first heading)

course.description: a spec.courses key, or null for a note in no course

label.description: his short label, such as Lecture 9 or Skills lab

earlierOf.description: D-326: the note this one is the kept earlier version of, when a stale save was refused

archivedAt.description: a mark: when he archived it (null when he brings it back)

discardedAt.description: a mark: when it was discarded (null when Undo brings it back); the note itself is kept

block.description: one line of the note: a paragraph, a heading, or one item of a bulleted, numbered or check list

run.description: plain text with its inline marks: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, and a link
